source.title: NASA Space Apps 2026 challenge statement: Flame in Freefall
source.note: Every summary below is taken from this statement. Saffire-II also uses the QABAS extraction of NASA PSI record PSI-99.

needs.label: Choosing cabin materials
needs.context: Prevention relies on material selection, which depends on understanding flammability limits.

needs.label: Detecting a fire
needs.context: Fire detection was tested in microgravity through smoke and aerosol measurements.

needs.label: Putting a fire out
needs.context: Suppression was studied by diluting the chamber atmosphere with carbon dioxide and helium.

needs.label: Oxygen-rich habitats
needs.context: The Moon Base and pressurized rovers are expected to use 30 % oxygen or more at 10.2 psi or less, which makes materials much more flammable.

needs.label: Moon and Mars gravity
needs.context: There is currently no partial-gravity combustion data in PSI. NASA expects it to be added from LUCI and FM2. Microgravity and normal-gravity results could bound what occurs in between.
